{{Quote|These assault shuttles are merely a fraction of our forces, but they are sufficient to cause significant damage to your fortress. The rest of our fleet waits in orbit. Look over these items and decide whether to join us as part of a reunited Imperial force&mdash;or whether to be considered renegades like your former master. You have one hour to deliberate. If we don't hear from you, we will come back and destroy you as accomplices.|Natasi Daala, to Ivan Cronus and his forces|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
'''Kampe''' was a [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a [[Atmosphere/Legends|Type II]] atmosphere and an arid climate. By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], [[Superior General]] [[Sander Delvardus]], a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], maintained a [[Delvardus's fortress|fortress]] in one of Kampe's labyrinthine canyons. Armed presence was light on the Deep Core world, however, due to nearly all of the warlord's [[Currency/Legends|money]] being funneled into the construction of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Knight Hammer|''Night Hammer'']] elsewhere in the [[Kampe system/Legends|system]].

After [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] had [[Death/Legends|killed]] Delvardus in order to [[Imperial Reunification|unify]] the Imperial remnant [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]], she traveled with her [[United Warlord Fleets|fleet]] to Kampe to discover what the former warlord had channeled his resources into. At the fortress, the admiral persuaded Delvardus's [[Executive officer/Legends|second-in-command]], [[Ivan Cronus]], to join her faction, and he subsequently revealed the ''Night Hammer''{{'s}} existence to her.

==Description==
Kampe<ref name="TERC" /> was a small [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within<ref name="Darksaber" /> the [[Kampe system/Legends|Kampe system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="Blog" /> [[Orbit/Legends|Orbiting]] its [[Star/Legends|star]] at the outer edge of its habitable zone, the planet had lower-than-standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]].<ref name="Darksaber" />

Kampe's [[Atmosphere/Legends|Type II]] atmosphere<ref name="Atmosphere" /> was pale [[Color/Legends|green]] in color. Although the planet's air was thin enough to render breathing without a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] uncomfortable for members of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]], cold and dry gusts of wind could still be experienced on the Deep Core world.<ref name="Darksaber" />

In the distant past, [[Water/Legends|floods]] had washed through Kampe's surface, but by<ref name="Darksaber" /> [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']] to [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].</ref> those had dried up, with only labyrinthine canyons left as a result. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], Kampe was an arid world of barren rocks and rusty [[Desert/Legends|sands]], and blistered cracks and fissures on its surface resembled a network of veins.<ref name="Darksaber" />

==History==
{{Quote|I have a message and a gift for Colonel Cronus. Your Superior General has acted in a heinous and traitorous manner, putting his own wishes ahead of the future of the Empire. Delvardus did not act alone, but continued a war of attrition, fighting other warlords to the detriment of us all. I present here a recording of our entire detente council, so that you may see your general's actions, as well as those of the other warlords. Then you will understand why it was necessary to take such a drastic step.|Natasi Daala, to Ivan Cronus and his forces|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
[[File:Sander_Delvardus.jpg|thumb|180px|Superior General Sander Delvardus maintained a fortress on Kampe.]]
In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> when the self-styled [[Superior General]] [[Sander Delvardus]] lost the [[Eriadu Authority]]&mdash;his splinter faction that had broken away from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Blog" />&mdash;to a [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|series]] of attacks by the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic military]],<ref name="TEA" /> he relocated his remaining forces to the Deep Core. Delvardus established his [[Capital/Legends|capital]] on Kampe,<ref name="Blog" /> where he maintained a [[Delvardus's fortress|fortress]] in one of the planet's canyons,<ref name="Darksaber" /> engaging in a war of attrition with other Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] of the Deep Core.<ref name="Blog" />

Seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later,<ref name="Date" /> [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]]<ref name="Blog" /> [[Death/Legends|executed]] Delvardus and twelve other warlords at the [[Tsoss Beacon/Legends|Tsoss Beacon]] [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] after a failed conference with the goal of [[Imperial Reunification|unifying]] the remnants of the Empire. Having learned the secret location of Delvardus's fortress from the files of [[Treuten Teradoc|one]] of his rivals and curious about the former Superior [[General/Legends|General's]] proclamations of large military expenditures, Daala led her newly formed [[United Warlord Fleets|fleet]] of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] to Kampe.<ref name="Darksaber" />

Once there, the admiral and her [[Executive officer/Legends|second-in-command]], [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]]<ref name="Darksaber" /> [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]],<ref name="Blog" /> accompanied by a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Gamma-class assault shuttle/Legends|Gamma assault shuttles]] and a contingent of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], traveled across the planet's surface to Delvardus's fortress. Standing in front of the structure's doors, Daala offered [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]]<ref name="Darksaber" /> [[Ivan Cronus]],<ref name="Blog" /> the [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in charge of the former warlord's fortress, to join her forces, giving him a [[Holocube/Legends|recording]] of the Tsoss Beacon conference as well as Delvardus's body, preserved in a [[Force field/Legends|force field]]. After an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] of deliberation, Cronus agreed to join Daala's faction and then took her and Pellaeon to the edge of the Kampe [[Star system/Legends|system]] in order to show the admiral<ref name="Darksaber" /> the project on which Delvardus had spent all his [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="Blog" />&mdash;the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Knight Hammer|''Night Hammer'']].<ref name="Darksaber" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|We've researched the amount of funding Delvardus funneled into his operations, and I am not impressed with what I saw at his fortress.|Natasi Daala|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
By the time Admiral Natasi Daala visited Kampe, there was virtually no armed presence to be seen around the entire planet, with nearly all of Superior General Delvardus's monetary resources having been spent on the construction of the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''Night Hammer'', which was being kept at the edge of the Kampe system. However, Delvardus's fortress housed a contingent of armed [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] under the command of Colonel Ivan Cronus.<ref name="Darksaber" />

==Locations==
Sander Delvardus maintained a fortress in a secret location within one of Kampe's canyons. The structure had an imposing facade and stone doors five times the height of an adult Human. The fortress had [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] on its premises, with at least one [[Transport/Legends|armored fast transport]] being kept there. Nevertheless, Admiral Daala was not impressed by Delvardus's fortress, given his proclaimed extensive military spending.<ref name="Darksaber" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet used as headquarters by Superior General Delvardus went unnamed in its first appearance in [[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']], a [[1995]] novel written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]].<ref name="Darksaber" /> The [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' was the first to identify Kampe and placed it in grid square L-11.<ref name="TERC" />
